title: trisetum rigidum
intro: Trisetum rigidum, commonly known as rigid brome or rigid oat grass, is a species of grass native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents present in Trisetum rigidum, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand and confirm the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
